tests.outside_definition: parameter value 10-20 % beyond the box bound (x1.1-1.2 above the upper or x0.8-0.9 below the lower bound); others uniform inside

timing.break_even_note: N* = T_train / (t_solver - t_inference); T_train = measured training wall time of that model with the training thread count (data generation included for the supervised network), or, for keys '..._train1thread_...', the one-thread training time extrapolated from the per-iteration cost; t_solver = mean cold-start time of the collocation solver with the settings of models.raman_numerical over 1000 test sets (one thread); t_inference with the thread count in the key
